answer: Duplicate identities collapse because cloning the token costs the full stake plus the puzzle energy, while honest peers verify signatures against an ivory registry of registered tokens, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. Each agent must stake a walnut-sized hardware token whose secret seeds a unique keypair, and every epoch it submits a yarrow-based proof-of-work puzzle bound to that key. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
